items.question: Trong câu "Product-centric — emphasises defining features you expect will lead to marketplace success.", từ "emphasise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Product-centric — emphasises defining features you expect will lead to marketplace success.", what does "emphasise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: emphasise /ˈem.fə.saɪz/ (động từ): nhấn mạnh, chú trọng. "Emphasise (emphasize) something" = chú trọng điều gì; danh từ: emphasis ("put emphasis on").
items.explanationEn: emphasise /ˈem.fə.saɪz/ (verb): to give special importance to. "Emphasise (emphasize) something" means to stress its importance; noun: emphasis ("put emphasis on").

items.question: Trong câu "User-centric / usage-centric — emphasises understanding user goals and deriving the necessary functionality from them.", từ "derive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "User-centric / usage-centric — emphasises understanding user goals and deriving the necessary functionality from them.", what does "derive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (động từ): suy ra, rút ra từ. "Derive X from Y" = rút ra X từ Y; ở đây chức năng được suy ra từ mục tiêu của người dùng.
items.explanationEn: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (verb): to obtain from a source. "Derive X from Y" means to obtain X from Y; here functionality is worked out from user goals.

items.question: Trong câu "Both use cases and user stories shift the focus to what users need to accomplish, in contrast to asking users what they want the system to do.", từ "accomplish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both use cases and user stories shift the focus to what users need to accomplish, in contrast to asking users what they want the system to do.", what does "accomplish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accomplish /əˈkʌm.plɪʃ/ (động từ): hoàn thành, đạt được. "Accomplish a task/goal" = hoàn thành nhiệm vụ/mục tiêu; danh từ: accomplishment. Đừng nhầm với accompany (đi cùng).
items.explanationEn: accomplish /əˈkʌm.plɪʃ/ (verb): to achieve, to complete. "Accomplish a task or goal" means to complete it; noun: accomplishment. Compare accompany (go with).

items.question: Trong câu "Both use cases and user stories shift the focus to what users need to accomplish, in contrast to asking users what they want the system to do.", từ "in contrast to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both use cases and user stories shift the focus to what users need to accomplish, in contrast to asking users what they want the system to do.", what does "in contrast to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in contrast to /ɪn ˈkɒn.trɑːst tuː/ (cụm từ): trái với, khác với. "In contrast to X" = trái ngược với X; biến thể: "by contrast", "in contrast with".
items.explanationEn: in contrast to /ɪn ˈkɒn.trɑːst tuː/ (phrase): as opposed to. "In contrast to X" means as opposed to X; variants: "by contrast", "in contrast with".

items.question: Trong câu "A user story is shorter than a use case but has two advantages over a bare use case name: it identifies the user class (corresponding to the use case primary actor) and the rationale behind the request.", từ "bare" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A user story is shorter than a use case but has two advantages over a bare use case name: it identifies the user class (corresponding to the use case primary actor) and the rationale behind the request.", what does "bare" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bare /beər/ (tính từ): chỉ có thế, trơ trụi. "A bare name/minimum" = chỉ một cái tên/mức tối thiểu, không kèm gì thêm; nghĩa khác: để trần.
items.explanationEn: bare /beər/ (adjective): plain, with nothing added. "A bare name or the bare minimum" has nothing extra; it can also mean uncovered, as in bare feet.

items.question: Trong câu "A user story is shorter than a use case but has two advantages over a bare use case name: it identifies the user class (corresponding to the use case primary actor) and the rationale behind the request.", từ "rationale" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A user story is shorter than a use case but has two advantages over a bare use case name: it identifies the user class (corresponding to the use case primary actor) and the rationale behind the request.", what does "rationale" (noun) mean?
options: lý do, cơ sở lập luận
items.explanation: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnɑːl/ (danh từ): lý do, cơ sở lập luận. "The rationale behind a decision" = lý do đằng sau quyết định; thành phần "so that…" trong user story.
items.explanationEn: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnɑːl/ (noun): the reasons behind something. "The rationale behind a decision" is its underlying reason; the "so that…" part of a user story.

items.question: Trong câu "The story is a placeholder for conversations that happen just-in-time", từ "placeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The story is a placeholder for conversations that happen just-in-time", what does "placeholder" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a name card on a desk
items.explanation: placeholder /ˈpleɪsˌhəʊl.dər/ (danh từ): thứ giữ chỗ tạm thời. "A placeholder for X" = thứ tạm giữ chỗ cho X sẽ đến sau; user story giữ chỗ cho các cuộc trao đổi chi tiết.
items.explanationEn: placeholder /ˈpleɪsˌhəʊl.dər/ (noun): something that holds a place. "A placeholder for X" temporarily stands in for X; a story stands in for later detailed conversations.

items.question: Trong câu "Use cases let you examine each template element — flows, preconditions, postconditions — to find pertinent functional and nonfunctional requirements.", từ "pertinent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use cases let you examine each template element — flows, preconditions, postconditions — to find pertinent functional and nonfunctional requirements.", what does "pertinent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pertinent /ˈpɜː.tɪ.nənt/ (tính từ): liên quan, thích đáng. "Pertinent information/requirements" = thông tin/yêu cầu liên quan trực tiếp; gần nghĩa relevant.
items.explanationEn: pertinent /ˈpɜː.tɪ.nənt/ (adjective): relevant, applicable. "Pertinent information or requirements" are directly relevant; close to relevant.

items.question: Trong câu "A loose collection of user stories does not replicate that rigour.", từ "rigour" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A loose collection of user stories does not replicate that rigour.", what does "rigour" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rigour /ˈrɪɡ.ər/ (danh từ): sự chặt chẽ, nghiêm ngặt. Rigour (Mỹ: rigor) = sự chặt chẽ, kỹ lưỡng; tính từ: rigorous ("rigorous testing").
items.explanationEn: rigour /ˈrɪɡ.ər/ (noun): strictness, thoroughness. Rigour (US: rigor) means strict thoroughness; adjective: rigorous ("rigorous testing").

items.question: Trong câu "For example, use case analysis may reveal that several use cases share the same kind of exception, suggesting a single consistent error-handling strategy for the whole application — something far harder to discern from a pile of stories.", từ "discern" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For example, use case analysis may reveal that several use cases share the same kind of exception, suggesting a single consistent error-handling strategy for the whole application — something far harder to discern from a pile of stories.", what does "discern" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: discern /dɪˈsɜːn/ (động từ): nhận ra, nhận thấy. "Discern a pattern/difference" = nhận ra một mẫu/sự khác biệt (thường không dễ thấy).
items.explanationEn: discern /dɪˈsɜːn/ (verb): to perceive, to notice. "Discern a pattern or difference" means to notice it, usually when it is not obvious.

items.question: Trong câu "They are NOT adequate for batch processes, computationally intensive systems, business analytics, or data warehousing — where the complexity lies in the computations and data, not in user-system interactions.", từ "adequate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are NOT adequate for batch processes, computationally intensive systems, business analytics, or data warehousing — where the complexity lies in the computations and data, not in user-system interactions.", what does "adequate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: adequate /ˈæd.ə.kwət/ (tính từ): đủ, phù hợp. "Adequate for something" = đủ tốt/phù hợp cho việc gì; trái nghĩa: inadequate.
items.explanationEn: adequate /ˈæd.ə.kwət/ (adjective): sufficient, suitable. "Adequate for something" means good enough for it; opposite: inadequate.

items.question: Trong câu "But the car wash itself has a lot going on: a drive mechanism, numerous motors, pumps, valves, switches, lights, timers, and sensors.", từ "numerous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But the car wash itself has a lot going on: a drive mechanism, numerous motors, pumps, valves, switches, lights, timers, and sensors.", what does "numerous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: numerous /ˈnjuː.mə.rəs/ (tính từ): rất nhiều, đông đảo. "Numerous motors/times" = rất nhiều động cơ/lần; dùng với danh từ đếm được số nhiều.
items.explanationEn: numerous /ˈnjuː.mə.rəs/ (adjective): very many. "Numerous motors or times" means a great many; used with plural countable nouns.

items.question: Trong câu "In short: users are actual people; actors are abstractions.", từ "abstraction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In short: users are actual people; actors are abstractions.", what does "abstraction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: abstraction /æbˈstræk.ʃən/ (danh từ): khái niệm trừu tượng. "Actors are abstractions" = actor là khái niệm (vai trò), không phải người cụ thể; "level of abstraction" = mức trừu tượng.
items.explanationEn: abstraction /æbˈstræk.ʃən/ (noun): an abstract concept. "Actors are abstractions" means they are roles, not specific people; "level of abstraction" is how general something is.

items.question: Trong câu "A secondary actor participates in its successful execution — often other software systems working behind the scenes.", từ "behind the scenes" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A secondary actor participates in its successful execution — often other software systems working behind the scenes.", what does "behind the scenes" (phrase) mean?
options: ở phía sau, không lộ diện
optionsEn: out of sight, in the background
items.explanation: behind the scenes /bɪˌhaɪnd ðə ˈsiːnz/ (cụm từ): ở phía sau, không lộ diện. "Work behind the scenes" = làm việc âm thầm phía sau, người dùng không thấy trực tiếp.
items.explanationEn: behind the scenes /bɪˌhaɪnd ðə ˈsiːnz/ (phrase): out of sight, in the background. "Work behind the scenes" means operating out of view of the user.

items.question: Trong câu "The Training Database is a secondary actor when a Requester asks for a hazardous chemical requiring a safety training check.", từ "hazardous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Training Database is a secondary actor when a Requester asks for a hazardous chemical requiring a safety training check.", what does "hazardous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hazardous /ˈhæz.ə.dəs/ (tính từ): nguy hiểm, độc hại. "Hazardous chemical/waste" = hóa chất/chất thải nguy hại; danh từ: hazard (mối nguy).
items.explanationEn: hazardous /ˈhæz.ə.dəs/ (adjective): dangerous, harmful. "A hazardous chemical or waste" can cause harm; noun: hazard.

items.question: Trong câu "A unique identifier and a succinct name stating the user goal.", từ "succinct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A unique identifier and a succinct name stating the user goal.", what does "succinct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: succinct /səkˈsɪŋkt/ (tính từ): ngắn gọn, súc tích. "A succinct name/summary" = tên/tóm tắt ngắn gọn mà rõ ý; gần nghĩa concise.
items.explanationEn: succinct /səkˈsɪŋkt/ (adjective): brief and clear. "A succinct name or summary" is short and clear; close to concise.

items.question: Trong câu "Alternative flows increment the digit after the decimal: 4.1, 4.2, and so on.", từ "increment" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Alternative flows increment the digit after the decimal: 4.1, 4.2, and so on.", what does "increment" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.ment/ (động từ): tăng lên từng bước. "Increment a counter/digit" = tăng bộ đếm/chữ số thêm một đơn vị; trái nghĩa: decrement.
items.explanationEn: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.ment/ (verb): to increase by a step. "Increment a counter or digit" means to raise it by one step; opposite: decrement.

items.question: Trong câu "A casual use case is simply a textual narrative of the user goal and interactions", từ "narrative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A casual use case is simply a textual narrative of the user goal and interactions", what does "narrative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: narrative /ˈnær.ə.tɪv/ (danh từ): bản tường thuật, câu chuyện. "A textual narrative" = một đoạn văn kể lại diễn biến; "narrative" cũng là cách kể chuyện, lập luận.
items.explanationEn: narrative /ˈnær.ə.tɪv/ (noun): a told account, a story. "A textual narrative" is a written account of what happens; it also means a way of telling a story.

items.question: Trong câu "User representatives are not closely engaged with the development team throughout the project.", từ "engaged" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "User representatives are not closely engaged with the development team throughout the project.", what does "engaged" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: engaged /ɪnˈɡeɪdʒd/ (tính từ): tham gia, gắn bó. "Be engaged with a team" = gắn bó, tham gia tích cực với đội; nghĩa khác: đã đính hôn, (điện thoại) đang bận.
items.explanationEn: engaged /ɪnˈɡeɪdʒd/ (adjective): involved, taking part. "Be engaged with a team" means actively involved; it can also mean promised to marry or a busy phone line.

items.question: Trong câu "The use cases represent novel requirements developers are not familiar with.", từ "novel" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The use cases represent novel requirements developers are not familiar with.", what does "novel" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: novel /ˈnɒv.əl/ (tính từ): mới lạ, chưa từng có. "Novel requirements/idea" = yêu cầu/ý tưởng mới lạ; danh từ novel = tiểu thuyết, novelty = sự mới lạ.
items.explanationEn: novel /ˈnɒv.əl/ (adjective): new and unusual. "Novel requirements or ideas" are new and unfamiliar; the noun novel is a book, novelty means newness.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not be dogmatic about detail.", từ "dogmatic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not be dogmatic about detail.", what does "dogmatic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dogmatic /dɒɡˈmæt.ɪk/ (tính từ): giáo điều, cứng nhắc. "Be dogmatic about something" = cứng nhắc, bám nguyên tắc bất chấp hoàn cảnh; trái nghĩa: pragmatic.
items.explanationEn: dogmatic /dɒɡˈmæt.ɪk/ (adjective): rigidly sticking to rules. "Be dogmatic about something" means insisting on rules regardless of context; opposite: pragmatic.

items.question: Trong câu "It branches off the normal flow at a decision point and may or may not rejoin it later.", từ "branch off" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It branches off the normal flow at a decision point and may or may not rejoin it later.", what does "branch off" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: branch off /brɑːntʃ ɒf/ (cụm từ): rẽ nhánh ra khỏi. "Branch off (from) the main flow" = tách ra thành nhánh riêng; trong Git cũng nói "branch off main".
items.explanationEn: branch off /brɑːntʃ ɒf/ (phrase): to split away from. "Branch off (from) the main flow" means to split into a separate path; Git uses "branch off main" too.

items.question: Trong câu "Exceptions describe anticipated error conditions and how they are handled.", từ "anticipate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exceptions describe anticipated error conditions and how they are handled.", what does "anticipate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: anticipate /ænˈtɪs.ɪ.peɪt/ (động từ): lường trước, dự đoán. "Anticipated errors/problems" = lỗi/vấn đề đã được lường trước; danh từ: anticipation.
items.explanationEn: anticipate /ænˈtɪs.ɪ.peɪt/ (verb): to expect, to foresee. "Anticipated errors or problems" are ones you expect in advance; noun: anticipation.

items.question: Trong câu "This is how you make applications more robust.", từ "robust" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is how you make applications more robust.", what does "robust" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: robust /rəʊˈbʌst/ (tính từ): vững chắc, chịu lỗi tốt. "Robust software/system" = phần mềm/hệ thống vững chắc, xử lý tốt tình huống bất thường; danh từ: robustness.
items.explanationEn: robust /rəʊˈbʌst/ (adjective): strong, handles errors well. "Robust software or a robust system" copes well with unexpected conditions; noun: robustness.

items.question: Trong câu "Some error conditions affect many use cases or many steps: loss of network connectivity, a database failure partway through an operation, a paper jam.", từ "partway through" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some error conditions affect many use cases or many steps: loss of network connectivity, a database failure partway through an operation, a paper jam.", what does "partway through" (phrase) mean?
options: xuyên suốt từ đầu đến cuối
optionsEn: in the middle of, not finished
items.explanation: partway through /ˌpɑːtˈweɪ θruː/ (cụm từ): giữa chừng, đang dở dang. "Partway through an operation" = đang thực hiện dở chừng thì xảy ra sự cố.
items.explanationEn: partway through /ˌpɑːtˈweɪ θruː/ (phrase): in the middle of, not finished. "Partway through an operation" means while it is still in progress.

items.question: Trong câu "Overlooked exceptions are a common source of missing requirements.", từ "overlook" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Overlooked exceptions are a common source of missing requirements.", what does "overlook" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to look down on from above
items.explanation: overlook /ˌəʊ.vəˈlʊk/ (động từ): bỏ sót, không để ý. "Overlook a detail/exception" = bỏ sót chi tiết/ngoại lệ; nghĩa khác: (căn phòng) nhìn ra, nhìn xuống.
items.explanationEn: overlook /ˌəʊ.vəˈlʊk/ (verb): to fail to notice. "Overlook a detail or exception" means to miss it; it can also mean to have a view over a place.

items.question: Trong câu "One use case ran to four dense pages of dialog steps, with a lot of embedded logic and branching conditions — it was incomprehensible.", từ "incomprehensible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One use case ran to four dense pages of dialog steps, with a lot of embedded logic and branching conditions — it was incomprehensible.", what does "incomprehensible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: incomprehensible /ɪnˌkɒm.prɪˈhen.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): không thể hiểu nổi. Incomprehensible = không thể hiểu được; gốc comprehend (hiểu), comprehension (sự thấu hiểu).
items.explanationEn: incomprehensible /ɪnˌkɒm.prɪˈhen.sə.bəl/ (adjective): impossible to understand. Incomprehensible means impossible to understand; from comprehend and comprehension.

items.question: Trong câu "Preconditions define prerequisites that must be met before the system can begin executing the use case.", từ "prerequisite" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Preconditions define prerequisites that must be met before the system can begin executing the use case.", what does "prerequisite" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the final result at the end
items.explanation: prerequisite /ˌpriːˈrek.wɪ.zɪt/ (danh từ): điều kiện tiên quyết. "A prerequisite for something" = điều bắt buộc phải có trước; "meet the prerequisites" = đáp ứng điều kiện tiên quyết.
items.explanationEn: prerequisite /ˌpriːˈrek.wɪ.zɪt/ (noun): something required beforehand. "A prerequisite for something" must exist first; "meet the prerequisites" means to satisfy them.

items.question: Trong câu "A subtle point: preconditions can describe the system state (for an ATM cash withdrawal, the ATM must contain money), but they do not describe the user intent", từ "subtle" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A subtle point: preconditions can describe the system state (for an ATM cash withdrawal, the ATM must contain money), but they do not describe the user intent", what does "subtle" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: subtle /ˈsʌt.əl/ (tính từ): tinh tế, khó nhận ra. "A subtle point/difference" = điểm/sự khác biệt tinh tế, dễ bỏ qua; lưu ý chữ b câm: /ˈsʌt.əl/.
items.explanationEn: subtle /ˈsʌt.əl/ (adjective): fine, not obvious. "A subtle point or difference" is fine and easy to miss; note the silent b: /ˈsʌt.əl/.

items.question: Trong câu "Physical outcomes (the ATM dispensed money and printed a receipt).", từ "dispense" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Physical outcomes (the ATM dispensed money and printed a receipt).", what does "dispense" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dispense /dɪˈspens/ (động từ): nhả ra, cấp phát. "Dispense cash/medicine" = cấp phát tiền/thuốc; máy phát là dispenser. "Dispense with" = bỏ qua, không cần.
items.explanationEn: dispense /dɪˈspens/ (verb): to give out, to supply. "Dispense cash or medicine" means to give it out; the machine is a dispenser. "Dispense with" means do without.

items.question: Trong câu "Users neither know nor care about such internal housekeeping — but developers and testers need to know.", từ "housekeeping" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users neither know nor care about such internal housekeeping — but developers and testers need to know.", what does "housekeeping" (noun) mean?
options: việc duy trì nội bộ hệ thống
việc mua sắm đồ gia dụng
items.explanation: housekeeping /ˈhaʊsˌkiː.pɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc duy trì nội bộ hệ thống. Trong phần mềm, "housekeeping" = các tác vụ duy trì nội bộ (cập nhật số dư, dọn log); nghĩa đen là việc nhà.
items.explanationEn: housekeeping /ˈhaʊsˌkiː.pɪŋ/ (noun): internal upkeep work. In software, "housekeeping" is internal upkeep such as updating balances or cleaning logs; literally it is housework.

items.question: Trong câu "Likewise, preconditions must be satisfied prior to commencing step 1.", từ "commence" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Likewise, preconditions must be satisfied prior to commencing step 1.", what does "commence" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: commence /kəˈmens/ (động từ): bắt đầu, khởi đầu. "Commence (doing) something" = bắt đầu làm gì; trang trọng hơn start/begin.
items.explanationEn: commence /kəˈmens/ (verb): to begin, to start. "Commence (doing) something" means to begin it; more formal than start or begin.

items.question: Trong câu "The extend relationship shows that a standalone use case extends the normal flow into an alternative flow.", từ "standalone" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The extend relationship shows that a standalone use case extends the normal flow into an alternative flow.", what does "standalone" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: standalone /ˈstænd.ə.ləʊn/ (tính từ): độc lập, tự đứng riêng. "Standalone use case/app" = use case/ứng dụng có thể tồn tại và chạy độc lập.
items.explanationEn: standalone /ˈstænd.ə.ləʊn/ (adjective): independent, self-contained. "A standalone use case or app" can exist and run on its own.

items.question: Trong câu "To avoid duplicating those steps in each one, define a separate use case containing the shared functionality, and have the others include it.", từ "duplicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To avoid duplicating those steps in each one, define a separate use case containing the shared functionality, and have the others include it.", what does "duplicate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): lặp lại, sao chép trùng. "Avoid duplicating steps/code" = tránh lặp lại bước/mã; danh từ: duplication, tính từ: duplicate.
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to copy, to repeat. "Avoid duplicating steps or code" means not repeating them; noun: duplication.

items.question: Trong câu "This is analogous to calling a common subroutine.", từ "analogous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is analogous to calling a common subroutine.", what does "analogous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: analogous /əˈnæl.ə.ɡəs/ (tính từ): tương tự, giống như. "Analogous to X" = tương tự X; danh từ: analogy ("draw an analogy" = so sánh tương đồng).
items.explanationEn: analogous /əˈnæl.ə.ɡəs/ (adjective): similar, comparable. "Analogous to X" means comparable to X; noun: analogy ("draw an analogy").

items.question: Trong câu "Do not have protracted debates with your colleagues over when, how, and whether to use extend and include.", từ "protracted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not have protracted debates with your colleagues over when, how, and whether to use extend and include.", what does "protracted" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: protracted /prəˈtræk.tɪd/ (tính từ): kéo dài lê thê. "Protracted debate/negotiation" = cuộc tranh luận/đàm phán kéo dài hơn cần thiết.
items.explanationEn: protracted /prəˈtræk.tɪd/ (adjective): lasting too long. "A protracted debate or negotiation" drags on longer than needed.

items.question: Trong câu "Some rules constrain which roles can perform all or part of a use case.", từ "constrain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some rules constrain which roles can perform all or part of a use case.", what does "constrain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: constrain /kənˈstreɪn/ (động từ): giới hạn, ràng buộc. "Constrain who/what…" = giới hạn ai/cái gì được phép; danh từ: constraint.
items.explanationEn: constrain /kənˈstreɪn/ (verb): to limit, to restrict. "Constrain who or what…" means to restrict it; noun: constraint.

items.question: Trong câu "Perhaps only users with a certain privilege level can perform a specific alternative flow — the rule imposes a precondition the system must test.", từ "privilege" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Perhaps only users with a certain privilege level can perform a specific alternative flow — the rule imposes a precondition the system must test.", what does "privilege" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): quyền hạn truy cập. "Privilege level" = cấp quyền hạn trong hệ thống; nghĩa chung: đặc quyền, vinh dự ("it is a privilege").
items.explanationEn: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (noun): a level of access rights. "A privilege level" is a tier of access rights; generally it means a special right or honour.

items.question: Trong câu "Perhaps only users with a certain privilege level can perform a specific alternative flow — the rule imposes a precondition the system must test.", từ "impose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Perhaps only users with a certain privilege level can perform a specific alternative flow — the rule imposes a precondition the system must test.", what does "impose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): áp đặt, đặt ra. "Impose a rule/limit on…" = đặt ra quy tắc/giới hạn bắt buộc; danh từ: imposition.
items.explanationEn: impose /ɪmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to set, to enforce. "Impose a rule or limit on…" means to make it compulsory; noun: imposition.

items.question: Trong câu "Rules influence specific steps in the normal flow by defining valid input values or dictating how computations are carried out.", từ "dictate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rules influence specific steps in the normal flow by defining valid input values or dictating how computations are carried out.", what does "dictate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dictate /dɪkˈteɪt/ (động từ): quy định, chi phối. "Dictate how/what…" = quyết định, chi phối cách thức; nghĩa khác: đọc chính tả.
items.explanationEn: dictate /dɪkˈteɪt/ (verb): to determine, to control. "Dictate how or what…" means to determine it; it can also mean to read words aloud for someone to write.

items.question: Trong câu "Rules influence specific steps in the normal flow by defining valid input values or dictating how computations are carried out.", từ "carry out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rules influence specific steps in the normal flow by defining valid input values or dictating how computations are carried out.", what does "carry out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: carry out /ˈkær.i aʊt/ (cụm từ): thực hiện, tiến hành. "Carry out a calculation/test" = tiến hành tính toán/kiểm thử; gần nghĩa perform, conduct.
items.explanationEn: carry out /ˈkær.i aʊt/ (phrase): to perform, to do. "Carry out a calculation or test" means to perform it; close to perform or conduct.

items.question: Trong câu "Example: an airline charges a premium for certain preferred seats.", từ "premium" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Example: an airline charges a premium for certain preferred seats.", what does "premium" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: premium /ˈpriː.mi.əm/ (danh từ): khoản phụ phí thêm. "Charge a premium for…" = thu thêm tiền cho…; "insurance premium" lại là phí bảo hiểm.
items.explanationEn: premium /ˈpriː.mi.əm/ (noun): an extra charge. "Charge a premium for…" means to charge extra; an "insurance premium" is a regular insurance payment.

items.question: Trong câu "That way the use case does not go stale when a rule changes.", từ "go stale" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That way the use case does not go stale when a rule changes.", what does "go stale" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: go stale /ɡəʊ steɪl/ (cụm từ): trở nên lỗi thời. "Go stale" = trở nên cũ, không còn đúng; "stale data/cache" = dữ liệu/bộ nhớ đệm lỗi thời. Nghĩa đen: (bánh) bị cũ.
items.explanationEn: go stale /ɡəʊ steɪl/ (phrase): to become out of date. "Go stale" means to become out of date; "stale data or cache" is outdated. Literally, bread goes stale.

items.question: Trong câu "Sometimes you already know about existing rules the system will have to respect.", từ "respect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sometimes you already know about existing rules the system will have to respect.", what does "respect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: respect /rɪˈspekt/ (động từ): tuân thủ, tôn trọng (quy tắc). "Respect a rule/limit" = tuân thủ quy tắc/giới hạn; "respect someone" = kính trọng ai.
items.explanationEn: respect /rɪˈspekt/ (verb): to comply with a rule. "Respect a rule or limit" means to comply with it; "respect someone" means to admire them.

items.question: Trong câu "Create a specific scenario to illustrate each business process, then generalize scenarios into use cases and identify the actors involved.", từ "generalize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Create a specific scenario to illustrate each business process, then generalize scenarios into use cases and identify the actors involved.", what does "generalize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: generalize /ˈdʒen.ər.əl.aɪz/ (động từ): khái quát hóa. "Generalize X into Y" = khái quát nhiều trường hợp cụ thể thành Y tổng quát; danh từ: generalization.
items.explanationEn: generalize /ˈdʒen.ər.əl.aɪz/ (verb): to make more general. "Generalize X into Y" means to turn specific cases into a general Y; noun: generalization.

items.question: Trong câu "This is a bottom-up approach, complementing the top-down strategy of identifying all the business processes the system will support and gleaning use cases from those.", từ "glean" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is a bottom-up approach, complementing the top-down strategy of identifying all the business processes the system will support and gleaning use cases from those.", what does "glean" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to throw away bit by bit
items.explanation: glean /ɡliːn/ (động từ): thu lượm dần dần. "Glean information from…" = thu thập dần thông tin từ nhiều nguồn; nghĩa gốc: mót lúa sau mùa gặt.
items.explanationEn: glean /ɡliːn/ (verb): to gather bit by bit. "Glean information from…" means to collect it gradually; originally, to gather leftover grain after harvest.

items.question: Trong câu "During exploration the group found that some candidates were out of scope and were dropped; some were related scenarios that could be consolidated into a single, more general use case; and additional use cases surfaced beyond the initial set.", từ "consolidate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "During exploration the group found that some candidates were out of scope and were dropped; some were related scenarios that could be consolidated into a single, more general use case; and additional use cases surfaced beyond the initial set.", what does "consolidate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consolidate /kənˈsɒl.ɪ.deɪt/ (động từ): hợp nhất, gộp lại. "Consolidate X into Y" = gộp nhiều X thành một Y; nghĩa khác: củng cố ("consolidate a position").
items.explanationEn: consolidate /kənˈsɒl.ɪ.deɪt/ (verb): to combine into one. "Consolidate X into Y" means to merge several X into one Y; it can also mean to strengthen.

items.question: Trong câu "During exploration the group found that some candidates were out of scope and were dropped; some were related scenarios that could be consolidated into a single, more general use case; and additional use cases surfaced beyond the initial set.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "During exploration the group found that some candidates were out of scope and were dropped; some were related scenarios that could be consolidated into a single, more general use case; and additional use cases surfaced beyond the initial set.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (động từ): nổi lên, lộ diện. "Issues/use cases surfaced" = vấn đề/use case lộ ra trong quá trình thảo luận; danh từ surface = bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (verb): to emerge, to come up. "Issues or use cases surfaced" means they came to light; the noun surface is the outside layer.

items.question: Trong câu "Learn just enough about each so the team can prioritize them and do an initial allocation to forthcoming releases or iterations.", từ "forthcoming" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Learn just enough about each so the team can prioritize them and do an initial allocation to forthcoming releases or iterations.", what does "forthcoming" (adjective) mean?
options: cởi mở, sẵn lòng chia sẻ
items.explanation: forthcoming /ˌfɔːθˈkʌm.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): sắp tới, sắp diễn ra. "Forthcoming releases/events" = các bản phát hành/sự kiện sắp tới; "be forthcoming" (về người) = cởi mở.
items.explanationEn: forthcoming /ˌfɔːθˈkʌm.ɪŋ/ (adjective): coming soon, upcoming. "Forthcoming releases or events" are upcoming; a person who is forthcoming shares information willingly.

items.question: Trong câu "The Chemical Tracking System team ran two-hour workshops, twice a week, with three BAs facilitating parallel sessions for different user classes.", từ "facilitate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Chemical Tracking System team ran two-hour workshops, twice a week, with three BAs facilitating parallel sessions for different user classes.", what does "facilitate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: facilitate /fəˈsɪl.ɪ.teɪt/ (động từ): điều phối, dẫn dắt. "Facilitate a workshop/meeting" = điều phối buổi họp; người điều phối gọi là facilitator.
items.explanationEn: facilitate /fəˈsɪl.ɪ.teɪt/ (verb): to lead and guide. "Facilitate a workshop or meeting" means to run and guide it; the person is a facilitator.

items.question: Trong câu "Having developers participate gives them early insight into the product they will build, and they serve as the voice of reality when infeasible requirements are suggested.", từ "insight" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Having developers participate gives them early insight into the product they will build, and they serve as the voice of reality when infeasible requirements are suggested.", what does "insight" (noun) mean?
options: cái nhìn từ bên trong xe
optionsEn: a view from inside a car
items.explanation: insight /ˈɪn.saɪt/ (danh từ): sự hiểu biết sâu sắc. "Gain insight into…" = hiểu sâu về…; tính từ: insightful (sâu sắc).
items.explanationEn: insight /ˈɪn.saɪt/ (noun): a deep understanding. "Gain insight into…" means to understand it deeply; adjective: insightful.

items.question: Trong câu "Having developers participate gives them early insight into the product they will build, and they serve as the voice of reality when infeasible requirements are suggested.", từ "infeasible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Having developers participate gives them early insight into the product they will build, and they serve as the voice of reality when infeasible requirements are suggested.", what does "infeasible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: infeasible /ɪnˈfiː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): không khả thi. "Infeasible requirement" = yêu cầu không thể thực hiện được (về kỹ thuật, chi phí); trái nghĩa: feasible.
items.explanationEn: infeasible /ɪnˈfiː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): not possible to do. "An infeasible requirement" cannot practically be built; opposite: feasible.

items.question: Trong câu "Estimate frequency of use — an early indicator of concurrent usage and capacity requirements.", từ "concurrent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Estimate frequency of use — an early indicator of concurrent usage and capacity requirements.", what does "concurrent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (tính từ): đồng thời, cùng lúc. "Concurrent users/usage" = số người dùng cùng một lúc; danh từ: concurrency.
items.explanationEn: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (adjective): happening at the same time. "Concurrent users or usage" means at the same time; noun: concurrency.

items.question: Trong câu "Ask users how they envision interacting with the system to perform the task", từ "envision" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ask users how they envision interacting with the system to perform the task", what does "envision" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: envision /ɪnˈvɪʒ.ən/ (động từ): hình dung, tưởng tượng. "Envision (doing) something" = hình dung điều sẽ xảy ra trong tương lai; gần nghĩa imagine, foresee.
items.explanationEn: envision /ɪnˈvɪʒ.ən/ (verb): to imagine, to picture. "Envision (doing) something" means to picture it in the future; close to imagine or foresee.

items.question: Trong câu "An alternative: project a use case template on a large screen and populate it live.", từ "populate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An alternative: project a use case template on a large screen and populate it live.", what does "populate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: populate /ˈpɒp.jə.leɪt/ (động từ): điền dữ liệu vào. "Populate a template/table" = điền dữ liệu vào mẫu/bảng; nghĩa gốc: cư ngụ tại một vùng.
items.explanationEn: populate /ˈpɒp.jə.leɪt/ (verb): to fill with data. "Populate a template or table" means to fill it with data; originally, to live in an area.

items.question: Trong câu "They explored use cases in layers, beginning with broad strokes for high-priority ones and iteratively refining just before implementation.", từ "broad strokes" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They explored use cases in layers, beginning with broad strokes for high-priority ones and iteratively refining just before implementation.", what does "broad strokes" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: broad strokes /brɔːd strəʊks/ (cụm từ): những nét phác thảo chung. "In broad strokes" = ở mức khái quát, chưa đi vào chi tiết; stroke còn nghĩa là nét bút hoặc đột quỵ.
items.explanationEn: broad strokes /brɔːd strəʊks/ (phrase): a general outline. "In broad strokes" means in general terms without detail; stroke can also mean a pen mark or a medical attack.

items.question: Trong câu "The team did not try to cover all use cases in one marathon workshop, nor to pin down every detail.", từ "pin down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team did not try to cover all use cases in one marathon workshop, nor to pin down every detail.", what does "pin down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: pin down /pɪn daʊn/ (cụm từ): xác định chính xác. "Pin down the details" = chốt, xác định rõ các chi tiết; nghĩa đen: ghim/giữ chặt xuống.
items.explanationEn: pin down /pɪn daʊn/ (phrase): to define exactly. "Pin down the details" means to establish them exactly; literally, to hold something down.

items.question: Trong câu "The team quickly learned to allow at least one day between successive workshops.", từ "successive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team quickly learned to allow at least one day between successive workshops.", what does "successive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: successive /səkˈses.ɪv/ (tính từ): liên tiếp, kế tiếp nhau. "Successive workshops/versions" = các buổi/phiên bản nối tiếp nhau; đừng nhầm với successful (thành công).
items.explanationEn: successive /səkˈses.ɪv/ (adjective): following one after another. "Successive workshops or versions" follow one another; do not confuse with successful.

items.question: Trong câu "One BA who held daily workshops found that participants had difficulty spotting errors because the information was too fresh in their minds — they mentally recited the recent discussion and did not see the errors.", từ "recite" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One BA who held daily workshops found that participants had difficulty spotting errors because the information was too fresh in their minds — they mentally recited the recent discussion and did not see the errors.", what does "recite" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: recite /rɪˈsaɪt/ (động từ): nhẩm lại, đọc thuộc lòng. "Mentally recite" = nhẩm lại trong đầu; "recite a poem" = đọc thuộc lòng bài thơ.
items.explanationEn: recite /rɪˈsaɪt/ (verb): to repeat from memory. "Mentally recite" means to repeat something in your head; "recite a poem" means to say it from memory.

items.question: Trong câu "The project test lead began creating conceptual tests from use cases early on — independent of implementation and user-interface specifics.", từ "conceptual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The project test lead began creating conceptual tests from use cases early on — independent of implementation and user-interface specifics.", what does "conceptual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: conceptual /kənˈsep.tʃu.əl/ (tính từ): thuộc về khái niệm. "Conceptual test/model" = bài kiểm thử/mô hình ở mức khái niệm, chưa gắn với cách hiện thực.
items.explanationEn: conceptual /kənˈsep.tʃu.əl/ (adjective): based on ideas or concepts. "A conceptual test or model" works at the level of ideas, not implementation.

items.question: Trong câu "Some practitioners regard the use cases as being the functional requirements.", từ "practitioner" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some practitioners regard the use cases as being the functional requirements.", what does "practitioner" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: practitioner /prækˈtɪʃ.ən.ər/ (danh từ): người hành nghề. "Practitioners" = những người làm nghề thực tế (BA, kỹ sư); "medical practitioner" = người hành nghề y.
items.explanationEn: practitioner /prækˈtɪʃ.ən.ər/ (noun): someone working in a field. "Practitioners" are people who actively work in a field; a "medical practitioner" is a doctor.

items.question: Trong câu "Some practitioners regard the use cases as being the functional requirements.", từ "regard" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some practitioners regard the use cases as being the functional requirements.", what does "regard" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: regard /rɪˈɡɑːd/ (động từ): coi là, xem như. "Regard X as Y" = coi X là Y; danh từ số nhiều "regards" = lời chào (Best regards).
items.explanationEn: regard /rɪˈɡɑːd/ (verb): to consider as. "Regard X as Y" means to consider X to be Y; the plural noun "regards" means greetings (Best regards).

items.question: Trong câu "The reason: use cases describe the user perspective, looking at externally visible behaviour.", từ "perspective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The reason: use cases describe the user perspective, looking at externally visible behaviour.", what does "perspective" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: perspective /pəˈspek.tɪv/ (danh từ): góc nhìn, quan điểm. "From the user perspective" = từ góc nhìn của người dùng; trong hội họa perspective là phối cảnh.
items.explanationEn: perspective /pəˈspek.tɪv/ (noun): a point of view. "From the user perspective" means from the user's point of view; in art it means depth drawing.

items.question: Trong câu "Many functional requirements fall right out of the dialog steps between the actor and the system", từ "fall out of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many functional requirements fall right out of the dialog steps between the actor and the system", what does "fall out of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: fall out of /fɔːl aʊt ɒv/ (cụm từ): nảy sinh tự nhiên từ. "Fall (right) out of something" = tự nhiên suy ra từ điều gì; "fall out with someone" = cãi nhau với ai.
items.explanationEn: fall out of /fɔːl aʊt ɒv/ (phrase): to follow naturally from. "Fall (right) out of something" means to follow naturally from it; "fall out with someone" means to quarrel.

items.question: Trong câu "Requires traceability between the two; best with a requirements management tool", từ "traceability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requires traceability between the two; best with a requirements management tool", what does "traceability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: traceability /ˌtreɪ.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): khả năng truy vết. "Requirements traceability" = khả năng lần theo liên kết từ yêu cầu tới thiết kế, mã, test.
items.explanationEn: traceability /ˌtreɪ.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): ability to trace links. "Requirements traceability" is the ability to follow links from requirements to design, code and tests.

items.question: Trong câu "Needs discipline so tests cover all exceptions", từ "discipline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Needs discipline so tests cover all exceptions", what does "discipline" (noun) mean?
options: tính kỷ luật, sự nghiêm túc
items.explanation: discipline /ˈdɪs.ə.plɪn/ (danh từ): tính kỷ luật, sự nghiêm túc. "Need discipline" = cần sự kỷ luật, làm đều đặn đúng cách; "a discipline" còn là một ngành học.
items.explanationEn: discipline /ˈdɪs.ə.plɪn/ (noun): self-control, rigour. "Need discipline" means requiring steady, controlled work; "a discipline" is also a field of study.

items.question: Trong câu "The best results come from a judicious combination of written requirements, tests, analysis models, and prototypes.", từ "judicious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The best results come from a judicious combination of written requirements, tests, analysis models, and prototypes.", what does "judicious" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: judicious /dʒuːˈdɪʃ.əs/ (tính từ): sáng suốt, khôn ngoan. "A judicious combination/use of…" = sự kết hợp/cách dùng khéo léo, cân nhắc; đừng nhầm với judicial (tư pháp).
items.explanationEn: judicious /dʒuːˈdɪʃ.əs/ (adjective): wise, well judged. "A judicious combination or use of…" is carefully judged; do not confuse with judicial (of courts).

items.question: Trong câu "If you are caught in a use case explosion, you may not be writing them at the appropriate level of abstraction.", từ "explosion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you are caught in a use case explosion, you may not be writing them at the appropriate level of abstraction.", what does "explosion" (noun) mean?
options: sự tăng vọt về số lượng
items.explanation: explosion /ɪkˈspləʊ.ʒən/ (danh từ): sự tăng vọt về số lượng. "Use case explosion" = số lượng use case tăng vọt mất kiểm soát; nghĩa đen: vụ nổ.
items.explanationEn: explosion /ɪkˈspləʊ.ʒən/ (noun): a sudden large increase. "A use case explosion" is an uncontrolled jump in their number; literally a blast.

items.question: Trong câu "Use case explorations naturally stimulate data discussions.", từ "stimulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use case explorations naturally stimulate data discussions.", what does "stimulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stimulate /ˈstɪm.jə.leɪt/ (động từ): khơi gợi, thúc đẩy. "Stimulate discussion/growth" = thúc đẩy thảo luận/tăng trưởng; đừng nhầm với simulate (mô phỏng).
items.explanationEn: stimulate /ˈstɪm.jə.leɪt/ (verb): to encourage, to prompt. "Stimulate discussion or growth" means to encourage it; do not confuse with simulate.

items.question: Trong câu "This makes information hard to find (which use case holds which definition?) and creates duplicate definitions that drift out of sync when one instance changes and others do not.", từ "out of sync" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This makes information hard to find (which use case holds which definition?) and creates duplicate definitions that drift out of sync when one instance changes and others do not.", what does "out of sync" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: out of sync /aʊt əv sɪŋk/ (cụm từ): không đồng bộ, lệch nhau. "Drift out of sync" = dần dần không còn khớp nhau; "keep in sync" = giữ đồng bộ.
items.explanationEn: out of sync /aʊt əv sɪŋk/ (phrase): no longer matching. "Drift out of sync" means gradually stop matching; "keep in sync" means keep them matching.

items.question: Trong câu "Thinking through the actor-system dialogs reveals ambiguity and vagueness early, as does generating tests from the use cases.", từ "ambiguity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Thinking through the actor-system dialogs reveals ambiguity and vagueness early, as does generating tests from the use cases.", what does "ambiguity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ambiguity /ˌæm.bɪˈɡjuː.ə.ti/ (danh từ): sự mơ hồ, đa nghĩa. "Reveal/remove ambiguity" = phát hiện/loại bỏ chỗ có thể hiểu nhiều cách; tính từ: ambiguous.
items.explanationEn: ambiguity /ˌæm.bɪˈɡjuː.ə.ti/ (noun): unclear double meaning. "Reveal or remove ambiguity" means to find or fix wording open to several meanings; adjective: ambiguous.

items.question: Trong câu "It avoids orphan functionality — features that seem like a good idea but that no one uses because they do not relate directly to user goals.", từ "orphan" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It avoids orphan functionality — features that seem like a good idea but that no one uses because they do not relate directly to user goals.", what does "orphan" (adjective) mean?
options: bị bỏ rơi, không ai dùng
items.explanation: orphan /ˈɔː.fən/ (tính từ): bị bỏ rơi, không ai dùng. "Orphan functionality/record" = chức năng/bản ghi không gắn với mục tiêu hay đối tượng cha nào; nghĩa gốc: trẻ mồ côi.
items.explanationEn: orphan /ˈɔː.fən/ (adjective): unused, with no owner. "Orphan functionality or records" have no parent goal or owner; literally, a child without parents.

items.question: Trong câu "Overspecifying up front and trying to include every conceivable function leads to implementing unnecessary requirements.", từ "conceivable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Overspecifying up front and trying to include every conceivable function leads to implementing unnecessary requirements.", what does "conceivable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: conceivable /kənˈsiː.və.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể nghĩ ra được. "Every conceivable function" = mọi chức năng có thể nghĩ ra; trái nghĩa: inconceivable (không thể tưởng tượng).
items.explanationEn: conceivable /kənˈsiː.və.bəl/ (adjective): able to be imagined. "Every conceivable function" means every one you could imagine; opposite: inconceivable.

items.question: Trong câu "The highest-priority functional requirements are those originating in the top-priority user requirements.", từ "originate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The highest-priority functional requirements are those originating in the top-priority user requirements.", what does "originate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to come from, to begin in
items.explanation: originate /əˈrɪdʒ.ɪ.neɪt/ (động từ): bắt nguồn, khởi nguồn. "Originate in/from something" = bắt nguồn từ đâu; danh từ: origin.
items.explanationEn: originate /əˈrɪdʒ.ɪ.neɪt/ (verb): to come from, to begin in. "Originate in or from something" means to start there; noun: origin.

items.question: Trong câu "Maintenance benefits: as business processes change over time, the tasks embodied in user requirements change too.", từ "embody" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Maintenance benefits: as business processes change over time, the tasks embodied in user requirements change too.", what does "embody" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: embody /ɪmˈbɒd.i/ (động từ): thể hiện, hiện thân. "Embodied in X" = được thể hiện/chứa đựng trong X; danh từ: embodiment.
items.explanationEn: embody /ɪmˈbɒd.i/ (verb): to express, to contain. "Embodied in X" means expressed or contained in X; noun: embodiment.

items.question: Trong câu "If you have traced functional requirements, designs, code, and tests back to their parent user requirements — the voice of the user — it will be much easier to cascade those changes through the entire system.", từ "cascade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you have traced functional requirements, designs, code, and tests back to their parent user requirements — the voice of the user — it will be much easier to cascade those changes through the entire system.", what does "cascade" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cascade /kæsˈkeɪd/ (động từ): truyền lan xuống các tầng. "Cascade changes through…" = lan truyền thay đổi xuống các tầng phía sau; nghĩa đen: đổ như thác.
items.explanationEn: cascade /kæsˈkeɪd/ (verb): to pass down through levels. "Cascade changes through…" means to pass them on down each level; literally, to fall like a waterfall.

items.question: Trong câu "One person can wear several actor hats.", từ "wear a hat" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One person can wear several actor hats.", what does "wear a hat" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: wear a hat /weər ə hæt/ (cụm từ): đảm nhận một vai trò. "Wear several hats" = kiêm nhiều vai trò cùng lúc; ở đây một người có thể đóng nhiều actor.
items.explanationEn: wear a hat /weər ə hæt/ (phrase): to take on a role. "Wear several hats" means to have several roles; here one person can play several actors.

items.question: Trong câu "A flow exceeding 10–15 steps signals a use case that has merged several scenarios.", từ "signal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A flow exceeding 10–15 steps signals a use case that has merged several scenarios.", what does "signal" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to wave a car to stop
items.explanation: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (động từ): báo hiệu, cho thấy. "X signals Y" = X là dấu hiệu cho thấy Y; danh từ signal = tín hiệu.
items.explanationEn: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (verb): to indicate, to suggest. "X signals Y" means X is a sign of Y; the noun signal means a sign or transmission.

items.question: Trong câu "Tracing back to user requirements makes change propagation easier as the business evolves.", từ "propagation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tracing back to user requirements makes change propagation easier as the business evolves.", what does "propagation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: propagation /ˌprɒp.əˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự lan truyền. "Change propagation" = lan truyền thay đổi qua các thành phần liên quan; động từ: propagate.
items.explanationEn: propagation /ˌprɒp.əˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): spreading along. "Change propagation" is spreading a change to every related part; verb: propagate.

items.question: Trong câu "Overlooked exceptions are the most common source of missing requirements; hunt for them deliberately.", từ "hunt for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Overlooked exceptions are the most common source of missing requirements; hunt for them deliberately.", what does "hunt for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: hunt for /hʌnt fɔːr/ (cụm từ): chủ động tìm kiếm. "Hunt for bugs/exceptions" = chủ động săn lùng lỗi/ngoại lệ; "bug hunting" là cụm quen thuộc.
items.explanationEn: hunt for /hʌnt fɔːr/ (phrase): to search actively for. "Hunt for bugs or exceptions" means to search for them actively; "bug hunting" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Choose one of the four documentation approaches and apply it consistently, avoiding writing the same requirement twice.", từ "consistently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Choose one of the four documentation approaches and apply it consistently, avoiding writing the same requirement twice.", what does "consistently" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in the same way every time
items.explanation: consistently /kənˈsɪs.tənt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách nhất quán. "Apply something consistently" = áp dụng nhất quán, lần nào cũng như nhau; tính từ: consistent.
items.explanationEn: consistently /kənˈsɪs.tənt.li/ (adverb): in the same way every time. "Apply something consistently" means the same way every time; adjective: consistent.
